query: How long will the passport application process take?
reference_answer: The processing time for a passport is around 1 to 2 weeks. The processing time will be longer if your photograph does not meet the standard requirements.If you do not hear from us after 2 weeks from the date of application, you may contact us via the enquiry form for assistance.
answer: Without specific information, the passport application process typically takes about 4-6 weeks. [Document 1]
